title: The Hardest Word Made Him Rich
description:
Marlo forgot his best friend's birthday. Texting sorry didn't work. So he tried something else.

Watch how one awkward apology turned into a million-dollar idea, the broken oven that nearly ruined it, and why MegaSock's app couldn't compete.

New Marble Street story every day. Subscribe so you don't miss the next business.

Marble Street is an animated series about creative business ideas. Marlo, his street and every event are fictional. Made with AI tools (animation and voice).
